title: Local MAX_BODY_BYTES/MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES duplicate kith-core without compile-time check
description: message.rs:13-14 defines MAX_BODY_BYTES and MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES locally with the same values as kith-core/src/lib.rs:21-23. No static_assert or compile-time binding ties them. When the canonical limits in kith-core change, the local copy silently stays stale: the session object advertises the new limit to clients but Message/set enforces the old one. Fix: remove local consts and import from kith-core.
